messages:
maya: 20m until cutoff — hotfix deploy for the channel-rate issue. PR #6427 needs 2x LGTM. @sam @lee can you take a quick look? We need infra + runtime signoff and a tiny deploy note.
sam: I have a call in 10 but can review in ~5m and approve if CI is green.
lee: On it, running perf microbench + KV cache check now.
carter: Ops note: plan to canary at 5% for 15m then 50% if stable. I’ll pre-create dashboards.
nina: QA ran the regression suite on staging — no failures. Logs uploaded: /shared/logs/6427-smoke.zip
sam: CI passed for me. Left one tiny comment re: a nil check — can force-approve after patch if trivial. :eyes:
maya: If that nil-check change is trivial can we patch and merge before cutoff? Cutoff is 14:40 UTC.
lee: Pushed an amend that handles the nil check. Perf microbench delta <1% — looks safe.
release-bot: preflight checks completed: ci:passed, lint:passed, security-scan:passed.
sam: LGTM — approving now. ✅
carter: Dashboard for rollout: https://dash.internal/release/6427 — will start canary when merge goes through.
maya: Need one more LGTM from runtime — @lee are you good to merge?
lee: LGTM, monitoring hooks added. Go for merge.
maya: Merging in ~2m. Quick rollback snippet in case of issues:
```
# revert cherry-pick
git revert -m 1 $(git rev-parse HEAD)
# rollback deploy
kubectl rollout undo deployment/rw-runtime -n prod
```
maya: Thanks all — will post to #postmortems if we see any anomalies. :rocket:
release-bot: merged PR #6427 by maya at 1769990398. Canary rollout started at 1769990400.
